claim_boundary: C015 narrows direct P-versus-NP routes. No attack is decisive and no survival result is evidence of truth.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: Phi may hide circuit equivalence or a hard global computation
attacks.method: Require deterministic polynomial-time evaluation on the explicit circuit encoding and forbid oracle access to rewrite distance.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the seven-gate relation may have semantic clauses not covered by a simple edit budget
attacks.method: Separate the finite R7-shaped auditor from the exact relation and keep universal verification as the next gate.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: proving C_n equivalent D_n may already require the sought EF strength
attacks.method: Demand syntactically transparent equivalence generated by H111 rather than arbitrary equivalent endpoints.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: rewrite distance may not transfer to the exact EF system or P != NP
attacks.method: Use only the registered H035 simulation and record the separate NP != coNP to P != NP implication.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: one shared gate can rewrite many gadget copies simultaneously
attacks.method: Require canonical normalization and prove every legal step affects only polynomially many contribution classes; no proof exists yet.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: gadget potential contributions may cancel under composition
attacks.method: Make signed additivity an explicit theorem rather than infer it from finite experiments.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: amplification may create superpolynomial circuits
attacks.method: Require a polynomial-time acyclic composition operator and polynomial endpoint size.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: tiny chain checks may be mistaken for an asymptotic lower bound
attacks.method: Label the executable chain auditor finite and exclude it from the universal proof claim.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the anti-checker may still need coNP certificates
attacks.method: Restrict every listed error to a false negative with an explicit satisfying assignment.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the constructor may evaluate or solve every candidate circuit
attacks.method: Forbid arbitrary SAT or circuit-equivalence calls; construction must be polynomial in unary n alone.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: formula length may exceed the input length against which n^k is measured
attacks.method: Charge one canonical bit encoding and permit only polynomially related lengths with exponent translation stated explicitly.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: one list may defeat only one circuit rather than all circuits of the size bound
attacks.method: Retain the universal quantifier over all size-n^k candidate SAT circuits for each produced list.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a missing string may translate to an uncertified false positive
attacks.method: Require the decoder theorem to output only a satisfiable formula on which the circuit says zero.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the range-avoidance instance may be easier or stronger than the selected algorithmic class
attacks.method: Require an explicit truth-table map and preserve uniformity and circuit class at every reduction step.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: decoding may call SAT to choose the formula or assignment
attacks.method: Make the satisfying assignment part of the decoded range witness and forbid search beyond polynomial evaluation.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: truth-table encoding may be exponentially longer than the anti-checker parameter
attacks.method: Require polynomial formula and witness length in the range-instance encoding and state exponent translation.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the proposed lifts may be only statistically similar
attacks.method: Require exact multisets of rooted signed neighborhoods through radius qr.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: high-girth lifts may preserve local views but not opposite SAT status
attacks.method: Name explicit SAT and UNSAT families as the unresolved construction theorem.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a compiler may distinguish global counts even when individual neighborhoods match
attacks.method: Require equality of the full neighborhood-type multiset, including multiplicities.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: witness recovery may carry global information outside output symbols
attacks.method: Include every recovery annotation in the radius-qr ancestry and interpretation model used by H115.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: identical local types can assemble into globally different low-treewidth graphs
attacks.method: Recognize that local type inventory alone is insufficient and require a formal finite interpretation plus canonical decomposition argument.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: dynamic programming may depend on nonlocal decomposition choices
attacks.method: Require either canonical bounded-treewidth decomposition or invariance of the accepted state under all decompositions.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: local recovery annotations may not determine a full original assignment
attacks.method: Make compositional recovery part of the transfer theorem and charge every nonlocal merge operation.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the transfer may be presented as an unconditional lower bound
attacks.method: Keep H115 conditional on both an exact H114 family and a fixed interpretation model.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the language remains unspecified and the lower bound is the whole frontier
attacks.method: Route SAT-specific constructive work through H112/H113 while retaining H030 as the final nonuniform target.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: certified false positives require an UNSAT proof system
attacks.method: Replace the two-sided list by H112 false negatives only.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the witnessing formulas may be hard to prove tautologies without circularity
attacks.method: Keep H032 outside the three selected C015 funnels until an explicit noncircular f is supplied.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: range avoidance for circuits does not establish intersection with every infinite NP set
attacks.method: Separate universal proof-generator hitting from the SAT-specific one-sided decoder H113.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the chain lower bound lacks an explicit invariant
attacks.method: Create H110/H111 with a potential, local Lipschitz bound, transparent endpoints, and gap amplification.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: no separator invariant or reduction is fixed
attacks.method: Deprioritize the pair route relative to H110 and H112 until a concrete encoding and obstruction are supplied.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: the hard polynomial extraction remains as hard as unrestricted algebraic circuit lower bounds
attacks.method: Record recent CNF progress for restricted IPS without promoting it to full IPS.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: short PIT-axiom proofs may coexist with failure of the proposed uniform extraction
attacks.method: Retain both branches as unresolved and exclude them from the shortest C015 funnel.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: deterministic PIT yields a lower-bound disjunction rather than SAT circuit lower bounds directly
attacks.method: Classify PIT as a barrier breaker, not one of the three shortest current chains.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: current avoidance hardness does not imply hitting every infinite NP set
attacks.method: Narrow practical work to the SAT-specific H113 decoder.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: negative SAT errors lack NP certificates
attacks.method: H113 permits only decoded false negatives with satisfying assignments.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: a modest Circuit-SAT speedup does not itself yield an NP lower bound
attacks.method: Retain H057 as algorithmic support but not a direct terminal funnel.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: sparsity evades largeness but usefulness against all polynomial circuits remains unproved
attacks.method: Require a concrete property and explicit NP member before restoring priority.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: Boolean and arithmetic linear models are conflated
attacks.method: Keep H059 weakened until one field and gate model are fixed.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: no family yet defeats every fixed q,r compiler
attacks.method: Create H114 as the exact high-girth signed-neighborhood target and H115 as the transfer theorem.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: pseudoexpectation transport remains broader than needed for H106
attacks.method: Use H114/H115 to isolate a purely local indistinguishability route while preserving H107 as a stronger alternative.
